commands.search: Search by name, hotkey or action…
commands.emptyText: Pick a command from the list or create a new one.
commands.deleteInMenus: It will also be removed from {0} QuickMenu item(s).
commands.hotkeysHint: Keys, mouse buttons (Mouse 4, Mouse 5…), chords such as “Mouse 4 + Mouse 1” or the wheel with modifiers.
commands.noActions: This command does nothing yet. Add its first action.
commands.blockKeyHint: The active application does not receive the hotkey.
commands.remoteHint: Can be run from another device over UDP.
commands.webHint: Shows up in the web app (phone) of the paired devices.
commands.ignoreDisabledHint: Ignores the “Disable in” list for this command.
commands.processesHint: Leave empty to work everywhere. Type the process name (e.g. chrome).
editor.runAsAdminHint: Unchecked, it starts as the normal user (like double-clicking it), even though K-Desktop runs as administrator.
editor.waitForeground: Wait until it is in the foreground
editor.keysHint: Format: CTRL + SHIFT + N, F6, Enter, Mouse 1, Wheel Up… Press “Capture” to record it.
editor.textHint: Typed as is, any character (accents, emoji…). Line breaks press Enter.
editor.mouseHint: Screen coordinates “x,y”. “Capture position” gives you 3 seconds to place the mouse.
editor.placeMouse: Move the mouse to the desired position
editor.powerHint: Press Esc during the countdown to cancel.
editor.filterIcons: Icons and images (or a program to use its icon)
settings.faviconsHint: “Open web” actions show each page's own icon. It is downloaded once from the website itself and kept in the data folder.
settings.languageHint: Languages can be added, or texts changed, by dropping a JSON file in %APPDATA%\K-Desktop 5\Languages.
settings.translateHint: Saves the English texts as the starting point of a new language.
settings.exportTemplateTitle: Save it with the language code (e.g. fr.json)
settings.templateError: The template could not be saved
settings.startWithWindowsHint: Uses a scheduled task: starts with administrator rights without a prompt.
settings.trayIconHint: Without it, open K-Desktop with the hotkey or by running it again.
settings.showHotkeyHint: Click and press the new combination.
settings.exitHotkeyHint: Click and press the new combination.
settings.osdSample: This is how K-Desktop messages look
settings.udpEnabledHint: Lets you run commands marked as remote by sending their name or number.
settings.udpRemoteHint: When off, only requests from this PC are accepted.
settings.webEnabledHint: Control K-Desktop from your phone or any browser: your commands, the volume and the audio output. Put HTTPS on it with a reverse proxy (Caddy).
settings.webRemoteHint: When off, only connections from this PC are accepted (the proxy would have to run here).
settings.webLocalOnly: Running for this PC only: listening on the network needs K-Desktop to run as administrator.
settings.webError: The port could not be opened. Is another program using it?
settings.webPublicUrlHint: The proxy's HTTPS address, for the QR code. Empty: the one seen coming through the proxy.
settings.webBasePathHint: Only when the app is not at the root of its domain (e.g. /kdesktop).
settings.webProxyHint: Its X-Forwarded-* headers are trusted (phone IP, HTTPS). Empty: only from this PC.
settings.webProxyOnlyHint: From the network only the proxy is accepted: devices have to come in over HTTPS.
settings.webNoDevices: None yet. The web app does nothing until a device is paired.
settings.webRevokeConfirm: Revoke "{0}"? It will have to pair again to use the web app.
settings.webNotRunning: Turn on the web server first
web.pairHint: Scan the code with the phone's camera, or open the web app and type the code. It works only once.
web.pairNoHttps: This address is not HTTPS: the app will work but cannot be installed on the home screen. Put your proxy's address in "Public address".
pwa.noCommands: No commands for the web app. Turn on "In the web app" in each command.
pwa.noMenus: No QuickMenu has commands for the web app.
pwa.run.unavailable: That command is no longer available
pwa.pair.title: Pair with K-Desktop
pwa.pair.text: On the PC, open Settings › Web app › "Pair a device" and scan the QR code with the camera, or type the code here.
pwa.pair.name: Name of this device
pwa.settings.unpairConfirm: Unpair this device? To use the app again you will have to pair it again.
settings.disabledInHint: In these applications (games, for example) hotkeys do nothing, except commands set to always work.
settings.sideButtonsHint: Stops Mouse 4 / Mouse 5 from navigating back or forward in these applications, so they can be used as hotkeys.
settings.importConfirm: The whole current configuration will be replaced by the file. (A backup of the current one is kept automatically.)
settings.importError: The file is not a valid configuration
settings.reimportConfirm: Current commands and QuickMenus will be replaced by the K-Desktop 4 ones. (A backup of the current configuration is kept automatically.)
about.tagline: Hotkeys, QuickMenus and remote control for Windows
about.notElevated: without administrator rights (hotkeys won't work over elevated windows)
about.languagesText: Spanish and English are built into the program. To translate K-Desktop use «Export template» in Settings: it saves the English texts in %APPDATA%\K-Desktop 5\Languages under the language code (e.g. fr.json); translate them and pick the language in Settings. An es.json or en.json in that folder only changes the keys it contains.
picker.tooltip: Press it, then click the application's window
picker.prompt: Click the application's window · Esc cancels
picker.invalid: That window could not be identified
picker.unavailable: Hotkeys are disabled; type the process name
qm.editorHint: Drag commands, items, files, folders or links onto the menu (above / into / below an item). Right click for more · Double click or F2 renames · Del removes · Alt+↑↓ moves · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo · Ctrl+C / X / V / D.

launcher.hint: Type to search. ↑ ↓ to choose, Enter to run, Esc to close.

editor.macroHint: Shift + Esc stops the macro at any time (and the rest of the command). Any keys or buttons it was holding are released automatically.

macro.emptyTitle: Record what you do and repeat it
macro.emptyText: A macro stores your keyboard and mouse input with its timing. Create one, press “Record”, do what you want to repeat and finish with Shift + Esc. Then use it from any command with the “Play macro” action.
macro.testHint: Plays the macro once after 3 seconds (Shift + Esc to stop)
macro.createCommand: Create a command that plays it
macro.deleteUsed: {0} “Play macro” action(s) use it and will stop working.
macro.recordMovesHint: When off, only clicks (with their position), the wheel and the keyboard are recorded.
macro.stopHint: Shift + Esc ends the recording or stops the playback.
macro.noSteps: This macro is empty. Press “Record” or insert steps by hand.
macro.delayHint: Pause before this step, in milliseconds
macro.rawHint: Sends a relative movement like a real mouse does: that is what games and 3D programs read (pointer speed and acceleration apply). Unchecked, the pointer moves exactly that many pixels.
macro.noHooks: Hotkeys are disabled (--no-hooks): recording is not possible
macro.recordExisting: The macro already has {0} steps. Replace them with the new recording or add it at the end?

osd.audioNone: None of the audio devices in the list is connected
editor.audioHint: Each run switches to the next device in the list (devices that are not connected are skipped). With only one, it always switches to that one. Drag to change the order.
editor.audioSound: Test sound on the new device
kboard.listEmpty: Create a profile to remap keys and mouse buttons: Caps Lock as Ctrl, disable the Windows key in games, side buttons that copy and paste…
kboard.emptyText: K-Board changes what keys and mouse buttons do, everywhere or only in the applications you choose.
kboard.activeHint: Switches the profile on or off. It can also be done from a command or from the tray icon.
kboard.createCommand: Create a command that switches this profile on and off
kboard.deleteUsed: {0} command action(s) use it; they will no longer do anything.
kboard.appsHint: Empty = in all of them (except the ones in “Disable in”). With applications, the profile only works while one of them is in the foreground.
kboard.layerHint: Check Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win to remap combinations (e.g. Ctrl + J). Unchecked, the key itself is remapped and keeps any modifiers you hold.
kboard.captureSourceHint: Press the key, button or combination you want to remap
kboard.surfaceHint: Click a key or button to choose what it does. Remapped keys light up and show their new function; the dot means they have remaps with other modifiers.
kboard.keysHint: The key stays down while you hold the original one: it works for modifiers (Caps Lock → Ctrl) and in games. Left and right Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Win are in the list.
kboard.textHint: Typed as is, with any keyboard layout. Line breaks press Enter.
kboard.commandHint: Runs the command when the key is pressed; the key no longer reaches the application.
kboard.disableHint: The key or button does nothing while the profile is on.
kboard.normalHint: The key works normally. Choose another option to remap it.
kboard.warnClick: Careful: this profile works in every application. Changing the left or right click affects everything, K-Desktop included. If something goes wrong, switch the profile off from the tray icon.
kboard.warnSame: The key is remapped to itself: nothing changes.
kboard.noRemaps: This profile does not change any key yet.

tips.title: Did you know…?
tip.w.desktop: Shows the desktop at once; press it again to bring the windows back.
tip.w.lock: Locks the PC when you step away; everything stays open as you left it.
tip.w.run: Opens the Run box: type cmd, regedit, control, %temp%…
tip.w.search: Searches apps, files and settings. Pressing Win and just typing works too.
tip.w.quicklink: Opens the quick link menu: Task Manager, Terminal, Disk Management, shut down…
tip.w.clipboard: Clipboard history: paste anything you copied earlier, not just the last thing.
tip.w.emoji: Emoji, symbol (≠ € ©…) and GIF panel in any text box.
tip.w.snip: Snips part of the screen and copies it to the clipboard.
tip.w.printscreen: Captures the whole screen and saves it in Pictures\Screenshots.
tip.w.taskview: Task view: every window and the virtual desktops.
tip.w.newdesktop: Creates a new virtual desktop and switches to it.
tip.w.switchdesktop: Switches to the previous or next virtual desktop.
tip.w.closedesktop: Closes the current virtual desktop (its windows move to the next one).
tip.w.snaplayouts: Shows the snap layouts to place the window in a grid.
tip.w.minimize: Restores a maximized window; press it again to minimize it.
tip.w.snapside: Snaps the window to the left or right half of the screen.
tip.w.monitor: Moves the window to the other screen.
tip.w.stretch: Stretches the window to the full height of the screen, keeping its width.
tip.w.shake: Minimizes everything but the active window; repeat to bring them back.
tip.w.taskbarN: Opens the app pinned at that position of the taskbar, or switches to it.
tip.w.taskbarNew: Opens another window of the app pinned at that position.
tip.w.taskbarAdmin: Opens the app pinned at that position as administrator.
tip.w.taskbarCycle: Goes through the taskbar icons with the arrows; Enter opens.
tip.w.tray: Moves the focus to the notification area (tray icons).
tip.w.notifications: Opens the notifications and the calendar.
tip.w.quicksettings: Quick settings: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, volume, brightness, airplane mode…
tip.w.project: Chooses how to use several screens: duplicate, extend or just one.
tip.w.cast: Connects to a wireless display or device.
tip.w.gamebar: Game Bar: recording, screenshots, performance and audio.
tip.w.record: Starts or stops recording the active window (Game Bar).
tip.w.dictation: Voice typing in any text box.
tip.w.language: Switches the input language or keyboard layout.
tip.w.magnifier: Magnifier: zooms the screen in and out. Win + Esc closes it.
tip.w.peek: Peeks at the desktop while you hold it.
tip.w.secure: Security screen: lock, switch user, sign out or Task Manager.
tip.w.alttab: Switches windows. With Ctrl the switcher stays open and you pick with the arrows.
tip.w.altf4: Closes the active window. On the desktop, opens the shut down dialog.
tip.w.graphics: Restarts the graphics driver: handy when the screen goes black or freezes.
tip.w.hdr: Turns HDR on or off on displays that support it.
tip.w.mute: Mutes or unmutes the microphone in supported calls.
tip.e.address: Jumps to the address bar to type a path (or cmd to open a console there).
tip.e.newwindow: Opens another window on the same folder.
tip.e.newtab: Opens a new tab in File Explorer.
tip.e.closetab: Closes the tab or the window.
tip.e.switchtab: Goes to the next or previous tab.
tip.e.rename: Renames the item; Tab moves on to rename the next one.
tip.e.properties: Opens the properties of the selected item.
tip.e.preview: Shows or hides the preview pane.
tip.e.details: Shows or hides the details pane.
tip.e.up: Goes up to the parent folder.
tip.e.back: Goes back to the previous folder or forward again.
tip.e.copypath: Copies the full path of the selected file.
tip.e.permanent: Deletes without using the Recycle Bin (careful!).
tip.e.views: Changes the view: large icons, list, details, tiles…
tip.e.zoom: Changes the icon size without any menu.
tip.e.morecontext: Opens the full classic context menu, with extras like “Copy as path”.
tip.e.expand: In the folder tree: expands every subfolder of the selected one.
tip.e.fullscreen: Makes the File Explorer window full screen.
tip.e.taskbarShift: On the taskbar: opens another window of that app.
tip.e.taskbarAdmin: On the taskbar: opens the app as administrator.
tip.e.taskbarMiddle: On the taskbar: opens another window of that app.
tip.e.taskbarCtrl: On the taskbar: cycles through the windows of the app one by one.
tip.b.reopen: Reopens the last closed tab (repeat to get more back).
tip.b.private.keys: Ctrl + Shift + N | Ctrl + Shift + P
tip.b.private: Private / incognito window (Chrome and Edge · Firefox).
tip.b.tabnum: Jumps to the tab at that position.
tip.b.address: Selects the address bar to type another address or search.
tip.b.addressnewtab: In the address bar: opens the address in a new tab.
tip.b.dotcom: In the address bar: adds www. and .com to what you typed.
tip.b.find: Finds in the page; F3 / Shift + F3 go to the next or previous match.
tip.b.hardrefresh: Reloads the page bypassing the cache.
tip.b.back: Previous or next page (same as Mouse 4 and Mouse 5).
tip.b.bookmarksbar: Shows or hides the bookmarks bar.
tip.b.print: Prints the page or saves it as PDF.
tip.b.zoom.keys: Ctrl + Wheel | Ctrl + Plus | Ctrl + Minus
tip.b.zoom: Zooms the page in or out.
tip.b.space: Scrolls down or up one screen.
tip.b.topbottom: Goes to the top or bottom of the page.
tip.b.middleclick: On a link, opens it in the background; on a tab, closes it.
tip.b.ctrlclick: Opens the link in a background tab.
tip.b.ctrlshiftclick: Opens the link in a tab and jumps to it.
tip.b.shiftclick: Opens the link in a new window.
tip.b.alttext: Selects the text of a link without opening it.
tip.b.taskmgr: Browser task manager: which tab uses the most (Chrome and Edge).
tip.t.word: Moves the cursor word by word.
tip.t.delword: Deletes the previous or next word in one go.
tip.t.line: Goes to the start or end of the line.
tip.t.selline: Selects to the start or end of the line.
tip.t.doc: Goes to the start or end of the document.
tip.t.undo: Undo or redo (in File Explorer too: undoes moving, copying or deleting files).
tip.t.clipboard.keys: Ctrl + C | Ctrl + X | Ctrl + V
tip.t.insert: Copy and paste with the classic keys (works in consoles and terminals).
tip.t.clicks: Selects the whole word or paragraph.
tip.t.paragraph: Jumps to the previous or next paragraph.
tip.t.altcode: With the numeric keypad, types characters by their code: © (0169), € (0128), ñ (0241)…
tip.k.qmleft: In the QuickMenu, runs the item and closes the menu.
tip.k.qmright: In the QuickMenu, runs the item and keeps the menu open to launch several.
tip.k.qmmiddle: In the QuickMenu, opens K-Desktop to edit the command, or the whole menu.
tip.k.qmkeys: The QuickMenu works with the keyboard; first letters jump to each item and Shift + Enter keeps it open.
tip.k.qmtoggle: Pressing the QuickMenu hotkey again closes it.
tip.k.esc: Cancels K-Desktop countdowns: shutdowns, waits and messages.
tip.k.shiftesc: Stops the macro being played and releases any keys it was holding.
tip.k.show.keys: Ctrl + Alt + Home | Ctrl + Alt + End
tip.k.show: Opens or exits K-Desktop (changeable in Settings).
tip.k.chord: Mouse chords (a side button plus another button or the wheel) give lots of extra shortcuts without the keyboard.
tip.k.kboard: With K-Board you can turn Caps Lock into Ctrl, disable the Windows key in games or make a side button copy and paste.
tip.k.disabledin: In Settings → “Disable K-Desktop in”, add your games so no hotkey gets in the way while you play.
